svg.title: The moving-vector corner map
svg.desc: The intrinsic original nilpotent-fiber module admits a noninvariant normalized positive fiber vector. Its multiplier partial isometry produces the actual homomorphism a to V a V star, with group coefficient theta xi U g xi. Norm and trace are preserved, and a unitary multiplier rotation identifies the two full-corner K maps. A one-point C2 fiber-swap counterexample distinguishes the corrected map from failed rank-one compression. Exact proof: Proposition 13.30d and Corollary 13.30e, equations 13.103i-13.103n. Human-source context: Connes 1986 Remark 7.16(a).

g.text: The moving-vector corner map
Original fibers Y = Vₖ → X = V₁; C = L(E) ⋊ᵣ Γ. No invariant fiber vector is required.
A. A multiplier partial isometry gives an actual homomorphism
Q C Q = Aₓ
e C e ⊂ P C P
ιξ(a) = V a V*
V(a) = ξa ; ‖ξₓ‖₂ = 1 ; V*V = Q ; VV* = e ≤ P
Coefficient at g: f g θξ,U g ξ ; kernel: f g(p(y)) ξ(y) conjugate(U g ξ(z))
The vector has support proper over X. A compact base coefficient gives a compact pair kernel.
B. Multiplication uses the transported second vector
θξ,U g ξ · αg(θξ,U h ξ) = θξ,U gh ξ because ⟨U g ξ,U g ξ⟩ = 1
‖ιξ(a)‖ = ‖a‖ ; τP(ιξ(a)) = τQ(a) for a ≥ 0 ; ‖ιξ(a)‖₁ = ‖a‖₁
All matrix levels; ordinary matrix trace. External units: (a,λ) ↦ (ιξ(a),λ).
The external scalar unit and the physical projection e remain distinct.
C. A unitary path identifies the full-corner K map
Rt = 1 + (cos t − 1)(e + Q) + sin t (V − V*) ; 0 ≤ t ≤ π/2
R₀ a R₀* = a
Rπ/2 a Rπ/2* = ιξ(a)
(jP)* (ιξ)* = (jQ)* in both degrees. Positive choices are joined with norm² ≥ 1/2.
D. Exact C₂ model: one base point, two fiber vectors, transport swaps them
ξ = e₀, e = |e₀⟩⟨e₀|, w = |e₀⟩⟨e₁| U ⇒ w² = e, w* = w, but e U e = 0.
Still required: a characteristic closed differential cycle, its coefficient bounds and pairing.
Proof: (13.103i)–(13.103n). Source context: Connes (1986), Remark 7.16(a).
Original proof and diagram. The characteristic differential descent remains required.
